header: A doctor's DISCIPLINE (step 53a): Medicine, Surgery, ENT, Orthopaedics ... shown as a chip beside "EXE" on the person's card and as a "Discipline" column in the table. I state it only when it is KNOWN: it comes from the qualification the hospital's staff list prints (MD(MEDICINE), MS(ENT), D.ORTHO, MDS, DGO ...), kept in data/hospital_staff.json as the field `discipline` of the person, which can be edited by hand. A doctor with MBBS alone, or one the staff list does not have, gets NO chip and NO value (never a guess). The person is found by TICKET (the roster's ticket number), and only for a doctor.

symbols.name: disciplineFromQualification
symbols.sig: export function disciplineFromQualification(q: string | null | undefined): string | null
doc: Returns the discipline a printed qualification states, or null when it states none (MBBS alone, "MS" with no subject).

symbols.name: disciplineOfTicket
symbols.sig: export function disciplineOfTicket(ticket: unknown): string | null
doc: Returns the discipline of the doctor with this roster ticket, or null when it is not known.
